data.name: ClaudePlugin_Description
data.value: Opens Claude Code in a new terminal window in your codebase to analyse a message (uses your Claude Code login)

data.name: ClaudePlugin_WorkingDirectorySetting
data.value: Codebase Claude Code runs in (unset: the directory azsb was started in)

data.name: ClaudePlugin_AllowedToolsSetting
data.value: Tools Claude Code may use without asking, comma separated (empty: it asks for each)

data.name: ClaudePlugin_ModelSetting
data.value: Model, e.g. sonnet or opus (unset: Claude Code's)

data.name: ClaudePlugin_TerminalSetting
data.value: Command that opens a window running {script} in {dir} (unset: tmux window in tmux, else Terminal on macOS, Windows Terminal or cmd, x-terminal-emulator)

data.name: AnalyseMessageAction_CouldNotOpenTerminal
data.value: Could not open a terminal with {terminal}: azsb config set plugins.{plugin}.{key} "<command> {script}"

data.name: AnalyseMessageAction_Opened
data.value: Claude Code opened in a new window, in {directory}

data.name: ClaudeSettings_NoDirectory
data.value: Working directory {directory} does not exist: azsb config set plugins.{plugin}.{key} <path to your code>
